title: Add Deposit opens the work order dialog on the Finance tab
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with BOTH Part sales -> Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit, on the build under test.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  3. A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status. Seed it: Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), add a part (Add Part), and open the Finance tab.
custom_steps:
1. On the Finance tab, find and click Add Deposit.
  2. Read the dialog fields and the pre-filled Memo.
  3. Confirm Add Deposit is available while the sale is Estimate, Approved or Complete.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Finance tab shows Add Deposit; clicking it opens the same Create Deposit dialog a work order uses (Deposit Date, Payment Method, Deposit Amount, Reference Number, Memo).
  • The Memo pre-fills "Deposit for Part Sale" and the sale number (e.g. "Deposit for Part Sale P-196").
  • Add Deposit is available while the sale is Estimate, Approved or Complete.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “The part sale Finance tab offers Add Deposit”
  • S8-R2: “The dialog is the one a work order uses, worded for a part sale, and the memo pre-fills with “Deposit for Part Sale” and the sale number”
  • S8-R3: “A deposit can be added while the sale is Estimate, Approved or Complete”

Last checked against build v26.39.2-210868d on 10/1/2026.
